title: fix(cli): os build carries a package-relative OpenAPI connector spec into the artifact
body:
Fixes #28505
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os build` 现在把 `provider: 'openapi'` 连接器以包内相对路径引用的 OpenAPI 文档读出来,直接内联写进 `dist/objectstack.json`;路径无效时构建失败。
- 为什么改:装进别的运行时(`os package install` 或市场安装)只带过去那份 JSON,路径会按宿主自己的目录解析,找不到文件,连接器静默不出现;Stripe 应用装上即用不了。
- 风险与回滚:产物里 `providerConfig.spec` 由路径变成对象,体积随文档增大(Stripe 由约 4.7 KB 到 59.8 KB);读产物的云端流水线需接受内联形态(spec 本就允许)。回滚即还原本 PR,源码不需要改。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/utils/bundle-connector-spec-files.ts`(只识别 openapi 的 `spec` 字符串且非 http(s) 的那一种);`packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts` 新增的 4a-bis 段;`packages/qa/dogfood/test/install-local-connector-spec-file.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-stripe build`,预期输出一行 `Bundling connector spec files... 1 document (46.0 KB)`,且 `dist/objectstack.json` 里 `connectors[0].providerConfig.spec.openapi` 为 `3.0.0`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`os build` carries a package-relative OpenAPI spec into the artifact.** New `packages/cli/src/utils/bundle-connector-spec-files.ts`, wired in `compile.ts` right after the seed-file bundling, split the same way (`collect` = the gate, `place` = the assembly). For every connector entry (top level, `manifest`, and each `packages[i].manifest` body) with `provider: 'openapi'` whose `providerConfig.spec` is a non-empty string that is not an http(s) URL, the file is read relative to the directory holding `objectstack.config.ts`, confined to it by the runtime loader's own rule, parsed as JSON, and written in place of the path. Every other provider, key and form is written as before.
- **The build refuses a reference it cannot carry**: absolute, climbing out of the root, naming no file, or naming a file that is not a JSON object. Located at the entry (`connectors[0].providerConfig.spec`), in the text face and in `--json`.
- **Docs**: one paragraph in `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` (the `provider: 'openapi'` section) says the build carries the file.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

**What this changes for readers of the artifact** (the cloud ingestion pipeline among them): an artifact built by this CLI carries `providerConfig.spec` as the inline document object, never the path, and is larger by the document's size. The inline form is one the spec schema (`providerConfig: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())`) and the `openapi` provider already accept; no `packages/spec` change.

### The measurement (before any code), at `23d1303d`

Scratch app, `provider: 'openapi'`, `providerConfig.spec: './openapi/fixture.openapi.json'`, `auth: bearer` with the credential set:

1. `os build` wrote `dist/objectstack.json` (0.7 KB) with `providerConfig: { spec: './openapi/fixture.openapi.json' }`, no document.
2. Installed into the showcase (a different root) through `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, body exactly as `packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts` builds it for an artifact file: `200`, `hotLoaded: true`, `credentialRefs[0].status: set`.
3. The reconcile then logged, and `GET /api/v1/automation/connectors` did not list the instance at all (not even degraded):

```text
ERROR [Automation] failed to materialize connector instance 'qa28505_fixture' via provider 'openapi' (ADR-0097). {"error":"connector-openapi provider: connector 'qa28505_fixture' failed to read providerConfig.spec './openapi/fixture.openapi.json': package file ref './openapi/fixture.openapi.json' could not be read (resolved to '/home/user/objectstack-issue-28505/examples/app-showcase/openapi/fixture.openapi.json'): ENOENT ..."}
```

The install door caches the artifact JSON alone (`STORAGE_DIR/SAFE_ID.json`, `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` header), and `service-automation` hands every instance `createPackageFileLoader(this.options.packageRoot)`, the host's root. An installed package has no directory on disk, so "resolve against the installed package's own root" (route b) has nothing to resolve against without the artifact carrying the file anyway; route (a) needs no contract change, so it is the route taken. ADR-0097 (§ Deliberate scope boundaries) describes the file form as resolved against "the declaring stack/package root (`packageRoot`, CLI default: the `objectstack.config.ts` directory)" and does not anticipate an installed package having a root of its own.

After the fix, the real Stripe app (`packages/apps/connector-stripe`, now on `main`) builds to 59.8 KB with the 46.0 KB document inline, and installed into the showcase the same way it materializes `ready` with its eight actions.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/src/utils/bundle-connector-spec-files.test.ts` (unit tier): carried with its other keys kept; manifest and `packages[]` bodies; inline document, http(s) URL, another provider and a descriptor left as written; five refusals, each located and naming the reference, nothing changed.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/install-local-connector-spec-file.dogfood.test.ts`: spawns the BUILT `os build` on a one-connector app, asserts the artifact carries the document, installs it into the showcase through install-local and asserts `GET /automation/connectors` lists the instance `ready` with the document's operation. Declares a measured `test-budget: 20` (class: spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture).

<details><summary>Red before, green after, one ablation (dogfood file, reads the CLI's dist)</summary>

- Red, CLI dist built from `main`: `Tests 2 failed (2)` — `expected './openapi/fixture.openapi.json' to deeply equal { openapi: '3.0.3', …(3) }`; the listing held only the showcase's five connectors.
- Green after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`: `Tests 2 passed (2)`.
- Ablation, committed head `9b81f435`: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts --anchor 'placeConnectorSpecFiles(connectorSpecs);' --replacement 'void placeConnectorSpecFiles; /* ABLATED_SPEC_PLACE */' -- …` → `anchor 1 -> 0, blob daba252de551 -> 0994c37b6d13`; rebuild; `ablation-dist-preflight @objectstack/cli ABLATED_SPEC_PLACE` → `marker present in 1 built file`; `Tests 2 failed (2)`; restored `blob == HEAD (daba252de551) and git diff HEAD is empty`. Restore leg: rebuild; preflight `--absent` → `marker absent from all 772 built files`, `working tree clean against HEAD`; `Tests 2 passed (2)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Final head f6ca481e (after merging origin/main)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/bundle-connector-spec-files.test.ts src/utils/bundle-seed-files.test.ts` → `Tests 16 passed (16)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/install-local-connector-spec-file.dogfood.test.ts` → `Tests 2 passed (2)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-stripe test` → `Tests 16 passed (16)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` → exit 0 (`tsc --listFiles`: the dogfood program holds the new test; the CLI's `tsconfig.json` program covers `src/**` tests).
- CLI `integration` tier: declared to CI (no integration-tier file or spawn entry touched).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `os validate` does not run this gate; only `os build` does (seed files run in both). A missing spec file is therefore refused at build, not at validate.
- `os dev`'s watcher watches `objectstack.config.ts` and `src/`; a spec file outside `src/` (the Stripe app's `./openapi/`) edited during `os dev` reaches the running artifact at the next recompile, not on its own.
- A non-OpenAPI-3 document carried inline is refused at materialization naming "(the inline document)" rather than the file path.
- The runtime half is untouched: `loadPackageFile` / `resolvePackagePath` still resolve an installed package's file ref against the host root. Measured: an installed package naming `./src/system/connectors/status-openapi.json` materialized `ready` with the showcase host's own document. Reported for a separate card, not fixed here.
- ADR-0097's scope-boundary paragraph does not mention build-time carrying; an amendment note is the maintainer's call (governed surface, not edited here). `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md` recipe 1 stays correct ("ships in the package").

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families, local, head f6ca481e</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 90 commands; all 90 run, exit 0 each (two first exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET for unbuilt packages outside this diff — `check:skill-examples` needed `@objectstack/client-react` dist, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` seven package dists; built, re-run: `278 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)` and `113 published require entry point(s) across 70 package(s) load`). `--ran` reconciliation: `90 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint`) and `test:repo` are CI's.

</details>
